# Official procurement regression fixtures

Retrieved 12 September 2026 from the Cabinet Office's Find a Tender public OCDS interface, licensed under OGL v3 subject to its published exceptions.

- `uk9.json`: [notice 059886-2026](https://www.find-tender.service.gov.uk/api/1.0/ocdsReleasePackages/059886-2026), satisfactory KPIs and one unrated metric. Contact details omitted.
- `uk9-history.json`: [process ocds-h6vhtk-05d4a5](https://www.find-tender.service.gov.uk/api/1.0/ocdsRecordPackages/ocds-h6vhtk-05d4a5), reduced to dated procurement identity and contract fields used in supplier hydration. Contact details omitted.
- `uk11.json`: [notice 033574-2025](https://www.find-tender.service.gov.uk/api/1.0/ocdsReleasePackages/033574-2025), successful contract completion. Contact details omitted.

These fixtures are negative examples. They must not be presented as evidence of adverse performance or distress by the named organisations. Other fixtures constructed inline in tests are explicitly synthetic.
